terms.object: AgentJob — CSV-driven batch job that spawns one sub-agent per input row to process it against a templated instruction
attributes: name: String (format: agent-job-<first 8 chars of job_id>)
auto_export: bool (true — always export CSV on completion)
output_schema_json: Option<Value> (JSON Schema for expected result)

data_flows.transform: parse_csv → headers + rows; each row → AgentJobItem with item_id (source_id or row-N, suffix for duplicates), row_index, row_json, source_id
render_job_csv(headers, items) — produces CSV with input columns + job_id, item_id, row_index, source_id, status, attempt_count, last_error, result_json, reported_at, completed_at
JobProgressEmitter.maybe_emit — compute eta_seconds = remaining/rate, serialize AgentJobProgressUpdate

terms.object: AgentJobItem — one CSV row processed by one spawned worker sub-agent; carries input row, assigned thread, reported result, and per-item state
attributes: item_id: String (source_id or row-<row_index+1>; duplicates receive suffix -2, -3, ...)
row_index: i64 (0-based; user-facing row number = idx + 2 including header)
source_id: Option<String> (value from id_column, trimmed non-empty)
row_json: Value (JSON object: header → cell value as String)

data_flows.source: spawned worker agent calls report_agent_job_result(job_id, item_id, result, stop?)
data_flows.transform: db.report_agent_job_item_result(job_id, item_id, reporting_thread_id, result)

terms.object: AgentJobProgress — aggregated state snapshot of a running job, emitted to the parent session as background events
attributes: eta_seconds: Option<u64> (computed: remaining / rate, rate = processed/elapsed_seconds)

data_flows.transform: JobProgressEmitter.maybe_emit — gate by (force || processed changed || failed_items changed || last_emit_at elapsed >= PROGRESS_EMIT_INTERVAL)

terms.object: JobRunnerOptions — runtime parameters for the per-job loop; derived from session base instructions, turn context, and the requested concurrency
attributes: max_concurrency: usize (normalized: max(1, min(requested, MAX_AGENT_JOB_CONCURRENCY, agent_max_threads)))
spawn_config: Config (base snapshot for spawning each worker; produced by build_agent_spawn_config)

data_flows.transform: build_runner_options → normalize_concurrency + build_agent_spawn_config + depth-limit check

terms.object: ActiveJobItem — in-memory tracking entry for an item whose worker thread is currently alive; keyed by ThreadId inside the run loop
attributes: started_at: Instant (from now or reconstructed from item.updated_at age on recovery)
status_rx: Option<Receiver<AgentStatus>> (watch subscription to worker agent status)

data_flows.transform: insert into active_items HashMap<ThreadId, ActiveJobItem>

terms.object: Spawned sub-agent — a child thread created via agent_control.spawn_agent / spawn_agent_with_metadata; identified by ThreadId, tagged with agent_path, agent_nickname, agent_role
attributes: agent_path: Option<AgentPath> (canonical hierarchical task name, e.g., parent_path/task_name)
model: String (effective — from agent config snapshot or args)
session_source: SessionSource::SubAgent(SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { parent_thread_id, depth, agent_path, agent_nickname, agent_role })

relationships.direction: parent thread → child thread (self-ref via parent_thread_id + depth)

AgentStatus: (referenced — contains at least NotFound + non-final + final states; is_final() classifies terminals)

data_flows.source: spawn tool args (message/items, agent_type, model, reasoning_effort, fork_context/fork_turns) + turn config
data_flows.transform: build_agent_spawn_config → apply_requested_spawn_agent_model_overrides → apply_role_to_config → apply_spawn_agent_runtime_overrides → apply_spawn_agent_overrides → spawn_agent_with_metadata
thread_spawn_source → SessionSource::SubAgent(SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { ... })

DEFAULT_ROLE_NAME.default: used as role_tag when role_name is None

terms.object: SpawnAgentArgs — request payload for spawning one sub-agent; two variants (v1 and v2) differ in required fields and fork semantics
attributes: v1.items: Option<Vec<UserInput>> (exactly one of message/items must be provided)
v1.agent_type: Option<String> (trimmed; empty treated as None; resolves to role)
v1.fork_context: bool (default false; when true → FullHistory fork)
v2.fork_context: Option<bool> (rejected in v2 — 'use fork_turns instead')

terms.object: SpawnAgentForkMode — mode used when spawning with conversation history fork (imported from crate::agent::control)
CloseAgentArgs / CloseAgentResult — input and result for the close_agent tool; closes a live sub-agent and returns its status just before close
attributes: CloseAgentArgs.target: String (v1: ThreadId string; v2: path or thread_id, resolved via resolve_agent_target; v2 rejects root agent)

data_flows.transform: parse_agent_id_target (v1) / resolve_agent_target (v2) → subscribe_status.borrow_and_update() → agent_control.close_agent(agent_id)

terms.object: ResumeAgentArgs / ResumeAgentResult — v1-only; resumes a previously closed agent (or returns the current status of a live one) by ThreadId

data_flows.transform: ThreadId::from_string → next_thread_spawn_depth → if status == NotFound → try_resume_closed_agent (build_agent_resume_config, resume_agent_from_rollout with thread_spawn_source(agent_role=None, task_name=None))

terms.object: SendInputArgs / SendInputResult — v1-only; delivers a message/items to a live sub-agent, with optional interrupt of its current turn
attributes: SendInputArgs.interrupt: bool (default false; when true → interrupt_agent before sending)

data_flows.transform: parse_agent_id_target → parse_collab_input → if interrupt: agent_control.interrupt_agent → agent_control.send_input(thread_id, input_items)

terms.object: WaitArgs / WaitAgentResult — wait for agent(s) to reach a final status (v1: per-thread statuses; v2: mailbox-change signal)
attributes: v1.WaitArgs.targets: Vec<String> (ThreadId list; must be non-empty)
v1.WaitAgentResult.status: HashMap<String, AgentStatus> (key = agent_path or ThreadId.to_string())

relationships.direction: WaitArgs.targets → spawned-agent (v1 only; v2 waits on session mailbox)

data_flows.source: v1: subscribe_status per target → watch Receiver<AgentStatus>
data_flows.transform: wait_for_final_status (status.borrow → if is_final return; loop: status_rx.changed → re-check); collected via FuturesUnordered with timeout_at(deadline)
wait_for_mailbox_change (timeout_at(deadline, mailbox_seq_rx.changed))

terms.object: ListAgentsArgs / ListAgentsResult — v2-only; enumerates sub-agents of the current session, optionally filtered by an agent_path prefix

data_flows.transform: filtering by path_prefix if provided

terms.object: SendMessageArgs / FollowupTaskArgs — v2 text-only communication to a sub-agent; shared submission path differs only by MessageDeliveryMode (QueueOnly vs TriggerTurn)

data_flows.transform: handle_message_string_tool → message_content validate non-empty → handle_message_submission → resolve_agent_target → build InterAgentCommunication(sender_path, receiver_path, [], prompt, trigger_turn=true) → mode.apply(communication) (overrides trigger_turn per mode) → agent_control.send_inter_agent_communication(receiver_thread_id, communication)

terms.object: InterAgentCommunication — message envelope between agents carrying sender agent_path, recipient agent_path, optional attachments, prompt text, and trigger_turn flag
attributes: attachments: Vec<...> (empty vec in current code)
trigger_turn: bool (true = wake/TriggerTurn; false = QueueOnly — overridden by MessageDeliveryMode.apply)

data_flows.source: sender turn session_source agent_path + receiver_agent.agent_path + prompt
data_flows.transform: InterAgentCommunication::new + mode.apply (force trigger_turn)

terms.object: Collab lifecycle events — emitted pairwise (Begin/End) around each tool invocation so the session bus reflects spawn, interaction, wait, close, resume lifecycles
attributes: CollabAgentSpawnBeginEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, prompt, model, reasoning_effort }
CollabAgentSpawnEndEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, new_thread_id, new_agent_nickname, new_agent_role, prompt, model, reasoning_effort, status }
CollabAgentInteractionEndEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, receiver_thread_id, receiver_agent_nickname, receiver_agent_role, prompt, status }
CollabCloseEndEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, receiver_thread_id, receiver_agent_nickname, receiver_agent_role, status }
CollabResumeBeginEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, receiver_thread_id, receiver_agent_nickname, receiver_agent_role } (v1 only)
CollabResumeEndEvent: { call_id, sender_thread_id, receiver_thread_id, receiver_agent_nickname, receiver_agent_role, status } (v1 only)

data_flows.source: handler invocation (Begin) → tool action → handler result (End)
data_flows.transform: construct event struct with call_id, thread ids, status, etc.

terms.object: CollabAgentRef / CollabAgentStatusEntry — lightweight descriptors of a sub-agent used in wait events and wait result aggregation
attributes: CollabAgentRef: { thread_id: ThreadId, agent_nickname: Option<String>, agent_role: Option<String> }
CollabAgentStatusEntry: { thread_id: ThreadId, agent_nickname: Option<String>, agent_role: Option<String>, status: AgentStatus }

data_flows.source: receiver_thread_ids + agent_control.get_agent_metadata per id + per-thread status
data_flows.transform: build_wait_agent_statuses — order receiver_agents first (only ids present in statuses map), then append extras from statuses not already seen, sorted by thread_id string
data_flows.sink: Vec<CollabAgentStatusEntry> used in CollabWaitingEndEvent and WaitAgentResult

terms.object: AgentJobFailureSummary — per-failed-item diagnostic included in SpawnAgentsOnCsvResult when any items fail (up to 5 failures listed)

data_flows.transform: filter_map — drop items with empty last_error; if none remain but progress.failed_items > 0, set job_error fallback

terms.object: SpawnAgentsOnCsvResult — final result payload returned to the caller of spawn_agents_on_csv
attributes: job_error: Option<String> (last_error on the job, non-empty; fallback message when failures exist but details absent)
failed_item_errors: Option<Vec<AgentJobFailureSummary>> (None when no failures or all failure summaries empty)

data_flows.transform: serde_json::to_string(SpawnAgentsOnCsvResult)

terms.object: ReportAgentJobResultArgs / ReportAgentJobResultToolResult — payload a worker calls exactly once to persist its per-item result and optionally cancel the entire job
attributes: ReportAgentJobResultArgs.stop: Option<bool> (default false; if accepted and true → cancel job with message 'cancelled by worker request')

data_flows.transform: validate result.is_object → db.report_agent_job_item_result(job_id, item_id, reporting_thread_id, result) → if accepted && stop == true: db.mark_agent_job_cancelled(job_id, 'cancelled by worker request')

terms.object: Worker prompt — the text sent to each CSV-job worker sub-agent; embeds job_id, item_id, rendered instruction (from template + row), expected result schema, and the mandatory report_agent_job_result tool protocol
attributes: contents: job_id + item_id + rendered instruction + row_json (pretty) + output_schema (pretty or '{}') + instructions to call report_agent_job_result exactly once with { job_id, item_id, result: JSON object } and optional stop=true

data_flows.transform: render_instruction_template — escape literal {{ and }} to sentinels, replace {column} with row[column] (string value or JSON stringification), restore escaped braces

terms.object: SessionSource / SubAgentSource — hierarchical identity/lineage descriptor attached to every spawned sub-agent; encodes parent, depth, agent_path, nickname, role
attributes: SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { parent_thread_id: ThreadId, depth: i32, agent_path: Option<AgentPath>, agent_nickname: Option<String>, agent_role: Option<String> }
SubAgentSource::Other(String) — used for CSV jobs with value 'agent_job:<job_id>'

SubAgentSource (as used in SRC): ThreadSpawn { parent_thread_id, depth, agent_path, agent_nickname, agent_role }

data_flows.source: parent session.conversation_id + parent session_source + child_depth + agent_role + task_name (optional)
data_flows.transform: thread_spawn_source — if task_name: agent_path = parent.get_agent_path().unwrap_or(root).join(task_name); else None
